title: Compose — Revise Document — Output Schema (compose-revise-document)
description: Output schema for sprk_analysisaction sprk_actioncode='compose-revise-document' (spaarkeai-compose-r2 DEF-11). MIRRORS VERBATIM the outputSchema baked into infra/dataverse/actions/compose-revise-document.action.json (the systemPrompt/schema author surface). The dual-channel payload — edits[] (structured, ledger-backed pending track-changes, same shape as compose-draft-alternative's ComposeDraftPayload) and comments[] (anchored review-flag comments, DEF-13 path) — becomes the opaque SessionOutput.Payload written under the `compose` disposition before render (ADR-040). Azure OpenAI Structured Outputs compatible: additionalProperties:false, object-level required array, no anyOf/oneOf/discriminator; match_mode is a closed set via the `enum` keyword (NOT a property-level boolean required, which is FORBIDDEN).
$comment-required: Object-level required array only — property-level boolean 'required' is FORBIDDEN (OpenAiFunctionSchemaValidator). edits/comments MAY be empty arrays (e.g. flag-risks emits empty edits; align-clauses/improve-clarity MAY emit empty comments) but both arrays are always present. match_mode's closed set is expressed via the `enum` keyword.

edits.description: Structured edits (pending track-changes) this revision pass proposes. Empty for a flag-risks request (comments-only). Each item is exactly the compose-draft-alternative ComposeDraftPayload shape ({target_text, new_text, match_mode}).

target_text.description: The exact substring of documentText this edit replaces — copied VERBATIM so the editor can locate it.

new_text.description: The proposed replacement language — self-contained, drafting-ready prose (no placeholders, no commentary, no markup). Inserted as a pending track-change.

match_mode.description: How the editor locates target_text: 'strict' (this exact occurrence — default), 'first' (first occurrence of a shorter repeated fragment), or 'all' (every occurrence, e.g. a defined-term change).

comments.description: Anchored review-flag comments this revision pass proposes. The ONLY output for a flag-risks request (no rewrite). Each item anchors a comment to a verbatim span of documentText — materializes as an AnchoredAnnotation type:'comment' (DEF-13 path).

target_text.description: The exact substring of documentText this comment anchors to — copied VERBATIM so the editor can locate it.

comment.description: The review-flag text — concise, names the concrete risk or issue.

rationale.description: Concise plain-language explanation of the revision pass as a whole (≤1 short paragraph, ≤1500 chars) — names the intent applied and the concrete improvement, not a generic justification.

sources.description: Grounding for the revision — each entry is { type, id, snippet }. Empty array when the retrieval layer supplied no grounding — never fabricated.

id.description: The retrieval-layer identifier for the source — never fabricated.

snippet.description: A SHORT supporting excerpt from the source.
